_comment: Real context windows for models routed via the litellm proxy (:4000). Single source of truth for both the LM Studio native-models facade generator (gen-lmstudio-models.py) and ~/bin/mc-set-model. Keyed by litellm model_name (provider prefix like 'lmstudio/' stripped). Fireworks values from its /v1/models context_length; add a model here when you add it to litellm/config.yaml. See docs/followups/2026-08-10-letta-code-byok-context-window-128k-default.md
